proposed_widenings.name: grant_environmental_adaptation
proposed_widenings.justification: Water Breathing grants the ability to breathe underwater — a passive environmental capability. The v4 taxonomy has grant_sense, grant_hover, grant_resistance, and grant_proficiency but no atom for physiological/environmental adaptations (breathing medium, movement medium, terrain traversal). grant_sense is the closest analog but covers perceptual senses, not respiration.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation — grant_passive_capability variant
proposed_widenings.justification: The ongoing_effect family's OngoingOperation union only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. Passive capability grants (underwater breathing, spider climbing, fly speed) require a new operation kind that names the capability rather than modifying rolls or dealing damage. Without this variant the ongoing_effect family cannot encode Water Breathing honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Spell grants a continuous passive ability (breathing underwater) rather than modifying attack rolls or saving throws or dealing damage on hit.

proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime — ritual flag on action variant
proposed_widenings.justification: Water Breathing has a 1-action casting time but is also ritual-castable. The current action CastingTime variant is { kind: 'action' } with no ritual boolean. The ritual boolean exists only on the minutes variant. Recording ritual eligibility on an action-time spell requires either a new action-with-ritual variant or adding an optional ritual field to the action variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Source JSON: time: [{number:1, unit:'action'}] with meta: {ritual: true}.

notes: Spell structure maps cleanly to ongoing_effect (multi-target, timed 24h non-concentration, choose_up_to 10 targets). The sole blockers are: (1) no v4 atom for environmental capability grants, (2) OngoingOperation has no passive-capability variant to carry that atom, (3) secondary: action-time CastingTime lacks a ritual flag. Items (1)+(2) are co-dependent — the new operation variant would carry the new atom. Item (3) is an independent surface_widening that could be resolved separately.
